title: LocalAI Scout — erro do backend local
description: Corpo de toda resposta de erro de `scout serve`. Mapeamento de status: bad_request/invalid_json/schema_invalid 400, unauthorized 401, forbidden_origin/forbidden_host 403, not_found 404, method_not_allowed 405, payload_too_large 413, unsupported_media_type 415, bench_disabled 501, internal 500. A mensagem nunca ecoa o token nem o header Authorization.
